scope: Read-only Wi-Fi capture and operator multimeter readings; no START, ARM or calibration changes

operator_ground_difference_v.reference: Inverter J4 minus relative to Nucleo GND

limitations: Multimeter readings and telemetry were not synchronized samples.
The powered measurement chain has a nonzero reading at reported zero DC bus; physical source is not isolated.
The off-state ideal conversion does not exactly match telemetry; do not claim full measurement-chain validation.
Two RX_BUFFER_OVERFLOW events are now present in saved logs at 15:00:44 and 15:11:27; causation by J4 switching is not proven.
A per-capture PASS means no new errors within that window, not that all previous windows were error-free.
Do not subtract a constant offset or alter stored calibration based on these two readings alone.
ground_check: Completed by operator: displayed zero in both J4 supply conditions; do not request the same measurement again.
analog_hypotheses: ST schematic Figure 3 places BAT48JFILM D1 between Vbus sensing and 3.3 V; diode reverse leakage is a possible contributor, not a confirmed cause.
Other contributors include ADC sampling/input leakage, adapter connections and board leakage.
release_status: Not cleared for an energized motor attempt by this measurement. Resolve recurrent receive overflow and measurement-chain discrepancy; no calibration or firmware modified.
